description: Extension for `CronSettings` providing SwiftUI view components such as job rows, context menus, detail headers, and history cards for displaying and interacting with cron jobs within the UI.

methods.name: jobRow
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI view representing a row for a given `CronJob`, displaying its name and status pills.

methods.name: jobContextMenu
methods.description: Provides a context menu with actions like run, open transcript, enable/disable, edit, and delete for a `CronJob`.

methods.name: detailHeader
methods.description: Displays detailed header information for a `CronJob`, including controls for enabling, running, editing, and viewing transcript.

methods.name: detailCard
methods.description: Constructs a detailed information card about a `CronJob`, including schedule, description, agent, session, wake mode, last run info, status, and errors.

methods.name: runHistoryCard
methods.description: Displays the run history of a `CronJob`, with refresh capability and a list of recent run entries.

methods.name: runRow
methods.description: Creates a view for individual run log entries showing status, date, duration, summary, and errors.

methods.name: payloadSummary
methods.description: Displays a summary of the payload associated with a `CronJob` based on its payload type.
